description: Elixir warns 'function each/1 required by protocol P is not implemented (in module P.List)' through its behaviour checker (module/behaviour.ex:17). fz records an impl's callback set but never compares it with the protocol's (source_publish.rs register_protocol_impl / publish_protocol_impl_surface). Fix: at impl publish, compare the (name, arity) sets and warn under the new code protocol/missing-callback; when the callback exists at another arity, name that arity. fixtures/00096 (missing) and 00098 (wrong arity) pin the warning. 00097 and 00100 stay silent, as in Elixir. Proposal: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-p8p.4-findings.html (approved 2026-09-26). One commit. The fixture moves to fixtures/ and its port test is deleted in the same commit.
title: A protocol impl warns about missing callbacks (protocol/missing-callback)
